entities.name: Anna Karolína Schmiedlová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anna Karolína Schmiedlová is a Slovak inactive professional tennis player. On 12 October 2015, she reached her best WTA singles ranking of world No. 26. She has won three singles titles on the WTA Tour, two singles titles on the WTA Challenger Tour as well as 12 singles titles on the ITF Circuit.
